reason: In DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.java, the lazy refresh in getShortcutByGrantType (~lines 107-119) runs `grantsByShortcuts.put(shortcut, grantType)` without checking first, and getGrantTypeByShortcut (~lines 122-137) also adds entries unchecked. postInit (~lines 79-84) is the only place that checks for duplicate shortcuts, so a grant deployed later with an existing shortcut such as "ac" silently replaces the old mapping, and tokens using that shortcut then decode to the wrong grant type.
